files.description: Daily weather at one station (90 rows, one per day in date order from 2025-06-01, no gaps): date (YYYY-MM-DD), temp_c (mean temperature in degrees C, two decimals; about 1% empty), humidity (percent, whole number).

task_text: The standard error of the mean of a window is the sample standard deviation of its values (dividing by n - 1) divided by the square root of n, the number of values in the window. Using 7-day windows of temperature (each day and the 6 days before it; only windows with 7 temperatures count), on how many days does the standard error of the mean exceed 0.8 degrees? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Count of days whose complete trailing 7-day window has sample sd / sqrt(7) > 0.8.

predicted_direction.reason: rolling().sem() was larger on 2.x (sqrt(n - 1) divisor), so more days crossed the threshold; 3.x follows the task's definition.
